text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — HIGH severity for model-catalog route mismatch (svc: inference-router, rule: route->gptx-3.2-quantized-v2). PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Triggered at 2054123456 — service: inference-router — symptom: ~25% 5xx on EU region, spike in latency, elevated token usage. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> runtime -> sre.

samir (oncall): Acked. I'm on it from NYC. Seeing a bunch of 502s and tokenizer mismatch errors in the logs. chloe, any inbound support reports?

chloe (support): Got 3 customer tickets from EU orgs complaining about failed generation or partial outputs. One is blocking for a paying customer (enterprise). I've let them know we're investigating and they'll get an update in 30m.

jia (runtime): Jumping in. Quick snapshot: router forwarded requests to model variant `gptx-3.2-quantized-v2` which was promoted this morning. There's a mismatch: the model's tokenizer at /models/gptx-3.2/vocab.json is a different encoding than the catalog metadata expects. Errors: `TokenizerMismatchError: token id out of range` and then downstream `RuntimeError: decode failed`.

ravi (sre): We're also seeing CPU spin on the router pods while retries happen; retries are increasing QPS on the fallback path and causing cascading latency. CPU at 85% on two EU router nodes.

naomi (platform): I can roll back the catalog entry to previous revision (rev: r125 -> r124). I need 2 approvals for promotion rollback, but oncall can request emergency rollback. If we revert route to `gptx-3.2-quantized-v1` it'll restore tokenizer compatibility.

samir (oncall): Emergency rollback requested. naomi pls go ahead. Also set routing weight to 0 for the new variant to stop traffic.

naomi (platform): Running rollback now. Command: ```
# platform CLI
redwood catalog rollback --model gptx-3.2 --rev r124 --scope eu --reason "auto-pager: tokenizer mismatch causing 5xx"```

incident-bot: Action log: catalog.rollback initiated by naomi at 2054123520 — changeid: ch_89ab.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded at 2054123522 by samir (oncall). Escalation paused.

jia (runtime): Patching router routing table to force fallback while rollback completes: ```
PATCH /routes/gptx-3.2
{ "variants": { "gptx-3.2-quantized-v2": 0, "gptx-3.2-quantized-v1": 100 } }
``` Applied at 2054123535.

ravi (sre): Scaling router EU pool +1 and throttling retries at the router layer to prevent retry storm. Applying: `kubectl scale deployment router-eu --replicas=4` and set retry_limit=1 in router-config.

samir (oncall): Monitoring logs for errors. chloe keep customers updated: ETA for rollback completion?

naomi (platform): Rollback finished at 2054123578, changeid ch_89ab -> status: success. Catalog now points to rev r124 in EU.

incident-bot: Post-rollback health check triggered: 30s interval for 5 checks. Initial results: 3/5 successes, error rate trending down.

jia (runtime): After forcing routing and rollback, 5xx rate dropped to ~2% from ~25% within 2 minutes. Latency normalized on most requests. Token usage also back to expected baseline.

ravi (sre): Router CPU back to 45% after scale and retry throttle. No additional node OOMs.

samir (oncall): Great. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. We'll keep monitoring for 30 mins. Open action items:
- postmortem to understand how bad revision passed QA -> responsible: naomi + runtime team (jia)
- add pre-promotion tokenizer validation in catalog pipeline -> owner: runtime infra (jia)
- improve automated rollback permissions for urgent ops -> owner: platform (naomi)
- customer follow-ups: chloe (support)

chloe (support): Notified affected customers at 2054123690 with apologies and interim summary. Will follow up with postmortem link.

jia (runtime): Adding immediate guard in CI: `validate_tokenizer_compatibility()` will be added to promotion pipeline. Creating PR now.

naomi (platform): I'll update the rollout checklist and add an emergency rollback button in console for oncall.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 severity reduced to LOW — monitoring window started.

samir (oncall): Leaving final notes: Duration: ~6m to mitigate (page at 2054123456, resolved by 2054123578). Customer impact: partial fail for a small set of EU enterprise customers, degraded latency for others for ~4 minutes. Next steps as above. Dropping to watch. :white_check_mark:
